shared_rules.challenge_limit: Each exploration region has a daily challenge limit; after 5 single failures, the region cannot be challenged again that day.
shared_rules.daily_reset: 00:00 as printed in the in-game rules; timezone UNKNOWN.
shared_rules.first_clear_reward: First completion of a chapter challenge yields the first-victory reward.
shared_rules.repeat_clear_reward: Repeating a completed chapter yields a sweep reward.
shared_rules.fog_reset: When surface fog covers the underground world, cleared chapter progress resets; rankings are unaffected.
shared_rules.sweep_unlock: Clear chapters 1-10 in a region to unlock sweep for that region; at its next opening, previously cleared chapters may be swept before continuing.
shared_rules.troops: Hero Land, Beast Cave, Gem Cave, Underground Research and Equipment Forge supply level-10 troops; higher troop tech in Underground Research can raise troop level.
shared_rules.earth_heart: Uses the role's own troops without changing outdoor marches and troops are not injured; if troop level is too low, the expedition supplies troops to the minimum capacity.
